hikes.name: Spider Meadow
hikes.blurb: Up Phelps Creek into a long, flat meadow ringed by waterfalls and peaks, a gentle way into the high Glacier Peak country.

hikes.name: Spider Gap
hikes.blurb: Past Spider Meadow and up a snow-filled gully to a notch above Lyman Glacier's lakes.

hikes.name: Seven Fingered Jack
hikes.blurb: From Phelps Creek Trailhead, a 12.3-mile round trip to the top of Seven Fingered Jack (9,077 ft), with about 5,750 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Switchback Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Foggy Dew Trailhead, a 14.0-mile round trip to the top of Switchback Mountain (8,020 ft), with about 4,600 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Fifth of July Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Basalt Pass Trailhead, a 14.3-mile round trip to the top of Fifth of July Mountain (7,439 ft), with about 7,000 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Mount Maude
hikes.blurb: From Phelps Creek Trailhead, a 15.3-mile round trip to the top of Mount Maude (9,052 ft), with about 6,150 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Myrtle Lake
hikes.blurb: From Entiat River Trail, an 8.5-mile round trip to Myrtle Lake, with about 1,300 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Schaefer Lake
hikes.blurb: From Schaefer Lake Trailhead, an 8.2-mile round trip to Schaefer Lake, with about 2,850 feet of climbing.
